findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 53 mm is observed in the body of the pancreas. Obstruction of the superior mesenteric vein is noted, suggesting invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with both the celiac artery and splenic artery, suggesting invasion, with the celiac artery showing stenosis. No other local invasion factors are identified. Lymph node metastases are observed in one node at station 8a and two nodes at station 14t. No other metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH0 (no invasion of the common hepatic artery)
DU0 (no invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum)
S1 (serosal invasion)
RP1 (retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV0 (no invasion of the portal vein)
A1 (invasion of the celiac artery)
PL0 (no invasion of the pancreatic lymphatic vessels)
OO1 (obstruction of the superior mesenteric vein, suggesting invasion)

Task 2: Determine the classification for local invasion (T classification) of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the size of the tumor (53 mm) and the presence of invasion factors, the T classification is T3.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer in the body of the pancreas are:
- Station 8a (celiac lymph nodes)
- Station 14t (splenic lymph nodes)

The patient's metastatic lymph node stations are regional:
- Station 8a
- Station 14t

Counting only the metastatic lymph nodes within the regional stations:
- Station 8a: 1 node
- Station 14t: 2 nodes

Total count of involved regional nodes: 3

N classification: N1b

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

No distant metastases are observed, so the M classification is M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the results of Task 1 and Task 4:
- No criteria for Borderline Resectable (BR) or Unresectable (UR) are met.
- Classification: Resectable (R)

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

Based on the determined T, N, and M categories:
- T classification: T3
- N classification: N1b
- M classification: M0

The overall stage is Stage IIA.
